about: Release rules for Anees scores (Medi 2026-09-27: 'Enforce the agreed release threshold in code'). Read by scripts/accuracy_gates.py and the pages. Lowering release_threshold_pct is a rule change: only Medi, in writing, in RULES.md. tests/test_accuracy_gates.py fails if it drops below 95.

agreement_readings.within_pass: in each of the two latest consecutive passes, reader 1 and reader 2 agree on >= threshold % of rows (agreed / (agreed + disputed), scripts/full_audit_compare.py compare)
agreement_readings.between_passes: the settled rows of those two passes agree on >= threshold % (rows in both / union, scripts/full_audit_compare.py passes)
agreement_readings.open_question: plan/PROMPT-OVERNIGHT-FULL-AUDIT-2026-09-26.md says 'until two consecutive passes agree on >=95% of rows' - either reading fits; both are enforced until Medi picks one (plan/ACCURACY-AUDIT-2026-09-27.md, decisions)

check_required_when: only a single reviewer decided it (third reader alone, or a row the third reader added)
the two reader passes disagree on whether it exists (found in one pass only)
it is kept only from the 09-24 sweep (neither reader pass listed it)
the transcript under it is disputed (a hand note says the engine wrote something else)
